scope: SOURCE E01-E03 DEVELOPMENT diagnostic. Frozen RF predictions; no RF fitting, query-label alignment, RGB or E04. Canonical target is a different task and cannot satisfy original image-plane acceptance.
conclusion: All three canonical gates fail. RF is worse than independently aligned canonical TRAIN mean/clock, has negative record-centered R2, and its shuffled predictions have lower NJE in every room. Centroid/scale/global2D alignment is insufficient for this frozen predictor.

config.scope: SOURCE E01-E03 diagnostic only; no RFmodel fit/RGB/E04, new3D/camera-calibration or original-target efficacy claim
config.centre: Own17-joint centroid, not GTroot supplied to predictions. Centroid decomposition is orthogonal; hip root does not yield the same exact MSE decomposition
config.scale: Own RMS17-joint radius after centering. Guard1e-4 in normalized image units. Never use query GTscale for predictions
config.labels: All30subjects×27actions×297frames, balanced. Room-associated variance after subtracting globalaction×endpoint teacher means; room/person/view/execution/teacher effects remain confounded
config.bone_ratios: Twelve fixed projected2D limb/torso widths divided by per-pose shoulder-midpoint-to-hip-midpoint length; not physical bone lengths or 3D-invariant quantities
config.baseline: In EACH targetspace, fit TRAINlabel mean and endpoint-only TRAINmeans directly, NOT canonicalize an old mean. Same source-validation rotation/reflection opportunity for every method
config.rf_model: Frozen rawpacket CURRENTfullpose head, natural-linear/RFF choice from its original source-validation selection. No canonical re-selection of RFfamilies/alphas
config.alignment: Unit-body space only: one constant2x2 proper rotation or reflection+proper rotation permethod/perheldfold, min SOURCEVALcoordinateMSE, firstproper tie. ALL3fold choices on disk before heldscores
config.query_labels: Only scoring and descriptive teachergeometry; never used for query-specific centering/scale/rotation of predictions, calibration or state initialization
config.metrics: Original imageNJE/PCK alongside separately labeled new-targetNJE/PCK/record-centeredR2 and prediction-shuffle; no original-target acceptance replacement
config.degeneracy: Report invalid prediction/target counts, no silent worst-frame deletion; continuation requires100percent canonical coverage
config.gate: FrozenRF unit_body+sourceVALselectedorthogonal transform: lower NEWtargetNJE and no-worsePCK.05/.2 than BOTH independently-aligned canonicalTRAINmean and endpoint-only controls in EACH3rooms; positive canonicalrecordR2 and worseRFshuffleNJE inall3. Diagnostic only, not original image-plane acceptance
config.limitations: Centering/scaling/proper2Drotation/reflection do not remove yaw/depth foreshortening. This is not evidence that camera alone caused previous transfer failure. No per-query oracle alignment score is promoted

score_meanings.NJE: Mean Euclidean joint error divided by each target skeleton bounding-box diagonal. Lower is better.
score_meanings.PCK: Fraction of joints within threshold times the target bounding-box diagonal; thresholds .05/.1/.2. Higher is better.
score_meanings.record_pose_r2: Within each record subtract the predictions own per-joint coordinate mean from predictions and the teachers own mean from targets. Pool squared errors and teacher centered energy across records; score 1-SSE/teacher_energy. This removes both record means and tests temporal variation, not absolute-pose accuracy.
score_meanings.canonical_coordinate_units: Each pose independently subtracts its own 17-joint centroid and divides by its own RMS radius. A source-validation-only global orthogonal matrix follows. Canonical TRAIN controls are direct canonical-space means and need not have unit RMS.
score_meanings.reversals: Strict sign change in RF-minus-control NJE from native target to canonical target. Descriptive, different targets, not original-task efficacy or statistical significance.

folds.roles: Per held room: all 10 held people; remaining rooms have 16 TRAIN and 4 source-validation people.
folds.actions: All 27 actions. Same person never appears in TRAIN and source validation or held roles.

label_geometry.limits: Room effects confound view/person/execution/teacher. Temporal fractions use total target energy and are not an additional additive component of action-endpoint-residual variance. Projected bone ratios are not physical lengths or 3D invariants.

verification.rotation_reference: Analytic atan2 optimum, independent of builder SVD implementation

repair.nonfinite_warning: v1 attempted inf-inf during centering before invalid-mask return; synthetic warning-as-error reproduction preserved locally. Fixed after the finite-data v1 run by masking before arithmetic, restoring NaNs before return. No pose filling.

byte_manifest_scope: Hashes identify bytes, not scientific correctness, immutability or licensing certification.

permutation_control.scope: Independent within-record permutation of retained held prediction rows, with a new seeded generator per held-room fold. Same row permutation across coordinate stages. No refitting; preserves each recording prediction marginal, not temporal autocorrelation.
